hypothesis.statement: A numeric scorecard created before production evidence would hide the gap between a functioning blockout and an AAA digital human.
hypothesis.action: Require per-component state, local evidence, defects, likely causes, recommended modifications, confidence and review mode; calculate overall only when every component is scored and no blocking defect remains.
hypothesis.expectedResult: The current v001 scorecard remains honest and useful with measured/unverified states rather than fabricated numbers.

decision: Do not publish a percentage or overall quality score for v001. Preserve geometric measurements and blockers until component-specific evidence supports calibrated scoring.
nextEvidence: post-conform MetaHuman renders and Editor evidence sufficient to promote individual components from unverified/measured-not-scored to scored
